**Clarifying Newell Highway route**

The user is asking about the Newell Highway, likely in Australia. This highway runs north-south in New South Wales, starting in Tocumwal at the Victorian border and ending at Goondiwindi on the Queensland border. However, it officially terminates at Boggabilla, which is right next to Goondiwindi. The Newell Highway is known as route A39. It’s crucial to note that its terminus for NSW is technically at the NSW/QLD border near Goondiwindi or Boggabilla.**Detailing the Newell Highway**

The Newell Highway runs from Tocumwal, near Cobram on the Murray River, to Goondiwindi on the Macintyre River. It officially stretches about 1,060 km and passes through towns like Jerilderie, Narrandera, West Wyalong, Parkes, Dubbo, Gilgandra, Coonabarabran, Narrabri, and Moree. The highway ends at Boggabilla, just south of the border, before continuing to the border crossing at Goondiwindi. So, the highway starts at Tocumwal (Victorian border) and ends at Goondiwindi (Queensland border).
[/Thinking]

Đường cao tốc Newell (A39) bắt đầu tại Tocumwal, ở biên giới NSW–Victoria (bên sông Murray), và kết thúc tại biên giới NSW–Queensland ở Goondiwindi (gần Boggabilla).
